problem:
The random variable $X$ has the following probability distribution.

| $x$ | $-2$ | $-1$ | $0$ | $1$ | $2$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ${f}_{X}(x)$ | $0.2$ | $0.1$ | $0.1$ | $0.2$ | $0.4$ |

Let $Y={X}^{2}.$ The distribution of $Y$ is given below.

| $y$ | $0$ | $1$ | $a$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ${f}_{Y}(y)$ | $0.1$ | $b$ | $c$ |

What is the value of $a+c?$
